search_expected_tries — DRIVE pegsym op

• Data kinds: scalar × scalar → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.search_expected_tries(n_sym: 'int', phi_cap: 'float', order: 'str' = 'alternate', estimate_sigma: 'float | None' = None) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import pegsym; pegsym.search_expected_tries(n_sym: 'int', phi_cap: 'float', order: 'str' = 'alternate', estimate_sigma: 'float | None' = None) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("search_expected_tries"))

Usage

Expected number of tries of the rotation search (exact, when the unknown orientation error e is uniform over 1 period). With candidates c_k (rotation_search_plan), the k-th try succeeds when e first falls in [c_k − φ, c_k + φ] (period P), so E = Σ_k (1 − |∪_{i<k} I_i|/P). The computation splits the circle at the interval ends and, for each small interval, counts the index of the first candidate covering it (same value, O(M²) vector operations). If the step is exactly 2φ, E = (M + 1)/2 (closed). The ratio to a search unaware of the symmetry (period 2π, M₁ = ⌈π/φ⌉), ratio_vs_blind → 1/n. If estimate_sigma [rad] is given, e is assumed normal (wrapped to the period) with standard deviation σ around the estimate, and the expected count in "alternate" order is also returned (expected_with_estimate, numerical integration with 4,096 points). Returns expected, closed, M, blind_expected and ratio_vs_blind. Raises ValueError: n_sym < 1, phi_cap ≤ 0, sigma ≤ 0.
